narration: Can Apple Intelligence write your LTK captions for you?
First, link your photos inside the LTK Creator app.
Tap the Auto-Draft button to let Apple Intelligence analyse the image.
Review the suggested caption, pick a tone, and edit any wording.
Confirm product tags, then hit schedule or share instantly.
You can also trigger Auto-Draft via Siri or Photos app shortcuts.
Try LTK Auto-Draft today and see if AI fits your workflow.
